content.user_title: Add CloudBase AI Models to Web Apps
content.value_statement: Browser AI integration can fail when model groups, auth, or Token Credits are not prepared. This skill guides CloudBase preflight, model enabling, and SDK calls for web apps.
actual_capabilities: Routes browser and frontend AI requests to @cloudbase/js-sdk instead of a backend proxy.
Requires Token Credits eligibility and AI model group checks before SDK code is written.
Explains valid ai.createModel group names and separates group names from model IDs.
Provides generateText examples for non-streaming browser text generation.
Provides streamText examples for incremental UI updates in web apps.
Covers custom OpenAI-compatible model onboarding through CloudBase AI model APIs.
limitations: Does not cover Node.js backend or cloud function model calls.
Does not support image generation because the web SDK examples are text-focused.
Requires CloudBase MCP or console access to verify environment readiness.
Model availability and pricing must be checked live before enabling a model.

use_cases.title: Add Frontend AI Chat
use_cases.description: Build an authenticated React, Vue, or Next.js chat UI that calls CloudBase AI from the browser.

use_cases.title: Prepare Managed Models
use_cases.description: Check Token Credits, inspect enabled models, show pricing, and enable the selected CloudBase model safely.

use_cases.title: Standardize Web AI Setup
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable preflight, auth, and SDK pattern for teams adding AI features to web dashboards.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Text Generation
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a simple web page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ai-model-web to add a simple authenticated generateText call to my React page. Run the required preflight checks first.

prompt_templates.title: Streaming Dashboard Response
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup for a responsive UI.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ai-model-web to implement streaming answers in a Vue dashboard. Verify model readiness and show errors in the UI.

prompt_templates.title: Enable a Managed Model
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced setup with model catalog and pricing checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ai-model-web to enable the user-selected managed model after checking catalog pricing, then update the frontend SDK call.

prompt_templates.title: Onboard a Custom Provider
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced setup for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ai-model-web to onboard an OpenAI-compatible custom model group, confirm readiness, and wire it into a Next.js chat interface.

output_examples.input: Add a CloudBase AI summary button to my web app.
output_examples.output: A short implementation plan covering environment lookup, Token Credits status, enabled model checks, authentication, and browser SDK wiring.

output_examples.input: Make responses stream into my dashboard.
output_examples.output: A frontend streaming flow that updates the UI incrementally, handles errors, and confirms token usage after completion.

output_examples.input: Use a custom OpenAI-compatible model from CloudBase.
output_examples.output: A guided onboarding path that registers a custom model group, confirms readiness, and uses that group in the web SDK.

best_practices: Run eligibility and group readiness checks before generating SDK code.
Use verified user authentication and reject anonymous sessions for AI features.
Confirm exact model IDs and pricing from live CloudBase APIs before enabling models.
anti_patterns: Do not put vendor names or model IDs inside ai.createModel.
Do not assume deepseek-v4-flash or any model is already enabled.
Do not route browser use cases through a backend proxy unless explicitly required.

faq.question: What runtime does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets browser and frontend web apps that use @cloudbase/js-sdk for AI text model calls.

faq.question: Do I need a backend proxy?
faq.answer: No. The skill routes normal web use cases directly through the browser SDK after auth and preflight checks.

faq.question: Which group name should ai.createModel use?
faq.answer: Use cloudbase for managed models, hunyuan-exp only when returned by CloudBase, or a custom-* group for custom models.

faq.question: Can anonymous users call AI models?
faq.answer: No. The skill requires verified user authentication because anonymous users are denied AI model permissions.

faq.question: Does the skill support streaming responses?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes streamText guidance for incremental browser UI updates.

faq.question: Can it use third-party OpenAI-compatible models?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains custom model onboarding through the CloudBase console or CreateAIModel API.
